metadata.description: Taloud's plugin index: catalogs Claude Code plugins, each living in its own repo

plugins.name: sp1ne
plugins.description: Generic Claude Code skills bundle: lessons capitalisation, PR descriptions, conventions check, plan grilling, TDD, PRD/issues workflow, triage, handoff, project bootstrap.

plugins.name: sp1ne-hooks
plugins.description: Opt-in guardrail hooks, kept separate from sp1ne so consumers choose them explicitly: deny-ssh denies any Bash command invoking ssh; deny-risky-git-push denies force pushes, tag pushes and pushes to main/master/develop.
